paragraphs.source_en: By the end of the first year, only about 2 percent of the potential value of your capital has vanished ($10,700 vs. $10,500). By the 10th year, 17 percent has vanished ($19,700 vs. $16,300). By the 30th year, 43 percent has vanished ($76,100 vs. $43,200). And by the end of the 50-year investment period, costs have consumed 61 percent of the potential accumulation available simply by holding the market portfolio, leaving only 39% for the investor.
